# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin — Api Keys

> 3 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin under Api Keys. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Api Keys

- [List API Keys](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/api_keys/list.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Retrieve API Key (Admin API)](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/api_keys/retrieve.md): Retrieve information about a single API key in your organization, looked up by its ID.
- [Update API Key](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/api_keys/update.md): Update API Key
